legs: Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera glides slowly along the garden path as the golden light softens toward dusk and string lights come on, arriving close beside a young mother picking ripe tomatoes from a raised bed with her blond toddler on her hip, both laughing.

Single continuous steadicam move, no cuts. The camera glides on past the mother and child, continuing forward along the gravel garden path into dusk, lamps glowing, neighbors of all ages strolling ahead toward the softly lit pavilion.
